LESSON: RELIGIOUS CEREMONIES CEREMONY CEREMONY

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.1: Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: which can be shown in class, 1. Why are the religious ceremonies significant in modern society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. examine the three selected religious ceremonies performed in the four faiths
2. interpret the significance of the three selected religious ceremonies for social cohesion
3. participate in the religious ceremonies for social cohesion

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. examine the three selected religious ceremonies performed in the four faiths
   In simple words: practise until you can examine the three selected religious ceremonies performed in the four faiths. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. interpret the significance of the three selected religious ceremonies for social cohesion
   In simple words: practise until you can interpret the significance of the three selected religious ceremonies for social cohesion. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. participate in the religious ceremonies for social cohesion
   In simple words: practise until you can participate in the religious ceremonies for social cohesion. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony in the examples.
2. Explain Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony.
4. Show that you can: examine the three selected religious ceremonies performed in the four faiths

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Use different digital devices/ digital devices with assistive software for learners with special needs /print media to explore the following religious ceremonies,
2. Digital Literacy: learner enhances digital literacy skills when makes a video/participates in making an audio-visual clip on the religious ceremonies that can be shown in class.
3. Can relate the skills of writing essays for peer review on the traditions of religious ceremonies to the skills of writing learnt in English.
4. Role play Scriptures Sanatan/Vedic scriptures

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which can be shown in class, 1. Why are the religious ceremonies significant in modern society?
2. How do religious ceremonies contribute to the purification of the mind, body, and soul?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. examine the three selected religious ceremonies performed in the four faiths
2. interpret the significance of the three selected religious ceremonies for social cohesion
3. participate in the religious ceremonies for social cohesion

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
